final_unload_s.meaning: last unloading end; non-null only for CHECKED_ROUTE

people_with_checked_transport.meaning: people in groups with a supported witness trip in `trips`

groups_awaiting_checked_transport.meaning: group ids without a supported witness

trips.meaning: supported (checked) witness trips only; all groups when CHECKED_ROUTE, a witnessed subset otherwise

conditional_trips.meaning: a schedule that is legal only if the listed unknown intervals are open; NOT checked

optimistic_final_unload_s.meaning: earlier completion possible only if unknown inputs proved open

missing_information.meaning: {kind: UNKNOWN_EDGE_INTERVAL, edge_id, unknown_interval (as listed), traversal, vehicle_id, group_id, trip_kind, needed_for: ANY_FEASIBLE_SCHEDULE|EARLIER_COMPLETION_IF_OPEN}

failures.meaning: per-view chain failures: CAPACITY | NO_ADMISSIBLE_LEG | NO_VEHICLE_ASSIGNED

diagnostics.meaning: hypothetical counterfactual runs used for MODEL_SCOPED_NO_ROUTE reasons; never schedules

search.meaning: settled_labels, label_cap, time_limit_s, cap_reached, supported_view, optimistic_view

gated_from_status.meaning: original status when an emitted witness failed replay and was withheld as UNRESOLVED

kind.meaning: 'outbound' (carries a group) or 'empty_return' (destination -> origin, no people)

start_node.meaning: origin for outbound, destination for empty_return

end_node.meaning: destination for outbound, origin for empty_return

incoming_edge_at_start.meaning: edge the vehicle last arrived on (kept through waits; used for the first turn check); null only before the first trip

ready_s.meaning: vehicle availability (first trip), unloading end (return trip), or return arrival (later outbound) - integer seconds from exercise origin

boarding_start_s.meaning: outbound only; >= ready_s; boarding_end_s - boarding_start_s == board_s

boarding_end_s.meaning: outbound only; equals departure_s (holds happen at the facility before boarding)

departure_s.meaning: entry second of the first edge

arrival_s.meaning: exit second of the last edge (admission arrival)

edges.meaning: ordered traversals: {edge_id, from, to, entry_s, exit_s}; exit_s - entry_s == travel_s; occupies [entry_s, exit_s)

waits.meaning: {node, start_s, end_s, incoming_edge_id, phase: before_boarding|on_board|empty_vehicle, causes:[...]}

binding_constraints.meaning: constraints that forced waiting in the earliest-departure witness: EDGE_CLOSED|EDGE_UNKNOWN {edge_id, interval, delay_s} or DESTINATION_NOT_OPEN {window_open_s, delay_s}

uses_unknown_input.meaning: true only in conditional_trips (never in checked trips)

length_m.meaning: sum of edge length_m when every edge provides it (display only)
